records.title: Solid-State Sodium-Ion Battery Cell with High-Voltage NASICON Cathode and Polymer-Ceramic Composite Electrolyte
records.description: High energy density sodium-ion electrochemical storage device operating across wide temperature ranges for grid-scale renewable integration and electric mobility.
records.organization: International Advanced Research Centre for Powder Metallurgy and New Materials (ARCI)
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. R. Gopalan, M. B. Sahana

records.title: Stimuli-Responsive Self-Healing Polymer Nanocomposite with Reversible Diels-Alder Covalent Network for Structural Aerospace Coatings
records.description: Thermally and optically triggered autonomous crack-healing elastomeric coating incorporating functionalized graphene oxide for corrosion prevention in high-stress environments.

records.title: Lead-Free Piezoelectric and Magnetostrictive Multiferroic Composite for Acoustic Energy Harvesting and Intelligent Sensing
records.description: High-coupling coefficient ceramic-polymer flexible sensor membrane converting ambient vibrational and electromagnetic energy into electrical power.

records.title: Silicon-Carbon Composite Anode Material with Conductive Graphene Scaffolding for Fast-Charging High-Capacity Lithium-Ion Batteries
records.description: Three-dimensional porous silicon-carbon nanostructure mitigating volumetric expansion during rapid lithium intercalation for electric vehicle battery packs.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Surendra K. Martha, Chhail Bihari Soni
